. do analysis.do 

. * Workbench 1.8.11
. * project: glm_nb
. * run: 0.5
. * lineage_hash: bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb
> bbb
. * Coverage
. * full | model.glm:negative_binomial | native | 
. version 18

. set more off

. set type double

. capture program drop wb_repost

. program define wb_repost, eclass
  1.     args beta covariance
  2.     ereturn repost b=`beta' V=`covariance', rename
  3. end

. capture program drop wb_sha

. program define wb_sha
  1.     args filename expected
  2.     tempfile digestfile
  3.     shell shasum -a 256 "`filename'" > "`digestfile'"
  4.     tempname fh
  5.     file open `fh' using "`digestfile'", read text
  6.     file read `fh' line
  7.     file close `fh'
  8.     if substr("`line'",1,64) != "`expected'" {
  9.         display as error "SHA256 mismatch"
 10.         exit 9
 11.     }
 12. end

. 
. wb_sha "data.csv" "2e1b92f07632a8c88d047074f77cd6e5f9552b4f932f7d6ed2499161a0
> bf3084"


. frame create wb_src0

. frame change wb_src0

. import delimited using "data.csv", varnames(1) delimiters(",") encoding("UTF-
> 8") asdouble clear case(preserve)
(10 vars, 300 obs)

. frame copy wb_src0 wb_model_data1

. frame change wb_model_data1

. glm ynb x1 x2 x3, family(nbinomial 0.5) link(log) ml vce(eim) scale(1) iterat
> e(1000) tolerance(1e-12) ltolerance(1e-12)

Iteration 0:  Log likelihood = -504.88054  
Iteration 1:  Log likelihood = -504.06611  
Iteration 2:  Log likelihood = -504.06602  
Iteration 3:  Log likelihood = -504.06602  

Generalized linear models                         Number of obs   =        300
Optimization     : ML                             Residual df     =        296
                                                  Scale parameter =          1
Deviance         =  316.7128119                   (1/df) Deviance =   1.069976
Pearson          =  312.3961813                   (1/df) Pearson  =   1.055393

Variance function: V(u) = u+(.5)u^2               [Neg. Binomial]
Link function    : g(u) = ln(u)                   [Log]

                                                  AIC             =   3.387107
Log likelihood   = -504.0660218                   BIC             =  -1371.607

------------------------------------------------------------------------------
             |                 EIM
         ynb | Coefficient  std. err.      z    P>|z|     [95% conf. interval]
-------------+----------------------------------------------------------------
          x1 |   .3808453   .0628342     6.06   0.000     .2576925    .5039981
          x2 |  -.2980652   .0547109    -5.45   0.000    -.4052965   -.1908338
          x3 |  -.1083325   .1217725    -0.89   0.374    -.3470022    .1303372
       _cons |   .5294191   .1402803     3.77   0.000     .2544748    .8043633
------------------------------------------------------------------------------

. assert e(converged) == 1

. estimates store wb_model1

. generate long wb_sample_row = _n

. generate byte wb_sample1 = e(sample)

. scalar wb_number_0 = _b[_cons]

. scalar wb_number_1 = _b[x1]

. scalar wb_number_2 = _b[x2]

. scalar wb_number_3 = _b[x3]

. scalar wb_number_4 = _se[_cons]

. scalar wb_number_5 = _se[x1]

. scalar wb_number_6 = _se[x2]

. scalar wb_number_7 = _se[x3]

. scalar wb_number_8 = e(N)

. file open wb_numbers using "numeric_actual.tsv", write text replace
(file numeric_actual.tsv not found)

. file write wb_numbers %21.17g (wb_number_0) _n

. file write wb_numbers %21.17g (wb_number_1) _n

. file write wb_numbers %21.17g (wb_number_2) _n

. file write wb_numbers %21.17g (wb_number_3) _n

. file write wb_numbers %21.17g (wb_number_4) _n

. file write wb_numbers %21.17g (wb_number_5) _n

. file write wb_numbers %21.17g (wb_number_6) _n

. file write wb_numbers %21.17g (wb_number_7) _n

. file write wb_numbers %21.17g (wb_number_8) _n

. file close wb_numbers

. * Closing self-checks
. assert !missing(wb_number_0) & abs(wb_number_0-(0.5294190766274965)) <= 1e-08
> +0*abs(0.5294190766274965)

. assert !missing(wb_number_1) & abs(wb_number_1-(0.3808453229171612)) <= 1e-08
> +0*abs(0.3808453229171612)

. assert !missing(wb_number_2) & abs(wb_number_2-(-0.29806517727677795)) <= 1e-
> 08+0*abs(-0.29806517727677795)

. assert !missing(wb_number_3) & abs(wb_number_3-(-0.10833250363412572)) <= 1e-
> 08+0*abs(-0.10833250363412572)

. assert !missing(wb_number_4) & abs(wb_number_4-(0.14028025583591924)) <= 1e-0
> 6+0*abs(0.14028025583591924)

. assert !missing(wb_number_5) & abs(wb_number_5-(0.06283421954867592)) <= 1e-0
> 6+0*abs(0.06283421954867592)

. assert !missing(wb_number_6) & abs(wb_number_6-(0.05471088883162485)) <= 1e-0
> 6+0*abs(0.05471088883162485)

. assert !missing(wb_number_7) & abs(wb_number_7-(0.1217725004803211)) <= 1e-06
> +0*abs(0.1217725004803211)

. assert !missing(wb_number_8) & abs(wb_number_8-(300)) <= 0.0+0.0*abs(300)

. 
end of do-file
